raw_response: {"translations":[{"id":"T0241","english":"When searching for the target object or the desklamp, first check open surfaces associated with the desklamp, such as desk, sidetable, nightstand, bed, dresser, sofa, coffeetable, armchair, shelf, etc.; once the desklamp is observed, go directly to the furniture it is on and use the desklamp if needed, do not keep iterating through many drawers or unrelated containers. If the target object is not on a reasonable open surface, then systematically search by container type (drawer/cabinet), and after finding it return to the desklamp. Avoid repeatedly look/examine the same location; when there is no new information, turn to other furniture or containers. 'under the desklamp' does not guarantee the target object or the desklamp is necessarily at the assumed location, so when the assumed location is not visible, search other surfaces and containers; if the desklamp is actually on other furniture such as sidetable/dresser, go to that furniture rather than repeatedly checking the original assumed desk."},{"id":"T0242","english":"When the target object is not at the first search location, continue systematically checking other possible containers and surfaces, such as cabinet, drawer, countertop, diningtable, stove, fridge, sinkbasin, coffeemachine, sidetable, etc. Maintain a record of checked locations, prioritize turning to not-yet-checked and already-open containers and visible surfaces, and avoid repeatedly returning to locations confirmed empty or repeatedly opening already-open containers. Do not declare the task blocked or the object nonexistent merely because the first location is empty. If several consecutive containers are empty, expand to open surfaces and other container types rather than endlessly searching drawer by drawer; for dish-type objects, prioritize open surfaces such as diningtable, countertop, and sidetable while also covering containers. After a broad search over a reasonable range, reassess rather than continuing to open every remaining container."},{"id":"T0243","english":"First confirm the locations of the target object and the desklamp. The desklamp is usually fixed on a furniture surface; after observing the desklamp, go directly to the furniture it is on, do not continue searching unrelated containers or blindly opening drawers, and do not treat the desklamp as a carryable object or navigation point. When the target object is not at the desklamp, first take it and carry it to that furniture; when the target object is already at the desklamp, first ensure the target object is in hand before interacting. After arriving, use use desklamp <id> with the instance number to trigger observation; do not use the bare name or compound syntax. Successfully turning on the desklamp is the termination condition, do not append use/look after it; if the target object has already been taken at that furniture, do not go to the same location again. If use desklamp returns Nothing happens, determine that there is no desklamp in the current furniture observation, and instead go to other furniture whose observation lists desklamp, rather than retrying at the same location."},{"id":"T0244","english":"First confirm the locations of the target object and the desklamp. The desklamp is usually fixed on a furniture surface; after observing the desklamp, go directly to the furniture it is on, do not continue searching unrelated containers or blindly opening drawers, and do not treat the desklamp as a carryable object or navigation point. When the target object is not at the desklamp, first take it and carry it to that furniture; when the target object is already at the desklamp, first ensure the target object is in hand before interacting. After arriving, use use desklamp <id> with the instance number to trigger observation; do not use the bare name or compound syntax. Successfully turning on the desklamp is the termination condition, do not append use/look/take/go after it; if the target object has already been taken at that furniture, do not go to the same location again. If the target object cannot be placed on the furniture where the desklamp is (put repeatedly shows no change), do not repeatedly attempt to place it, keep holding it and directly use desklamp <id>."},{"id":"T0245","english":"In failed trajectories, examine X with desklamp, examine the target object, examine desklamp, examine furniture (such as examine desk 1), bare-name use desklamp, use desklamp on X, use X on desklamp often return There's nothing special about X or Nothing happens, and cannot substitute for the observation condition. Merely placing the target object on the desk or desklamp without triggering the desklamp interaction also causes the task to appear complete while the environment goal is not achieved; if the placement itself repeatedly returns Nothing happens, all the more should you not continue attempting to place. The valid interaction form is to use the observed numbered lamp instance, for example use desklamp 1."},{"id":"T0246","english":"The environment does not support using the desklamp as a tool argument to examine, nor bare names or compound syntax, and examine furniture also does not provide valid information; the placement action itself does not trigger the observation success condition, and some furniture may refuse placement."},{"id":"T0247","english":"After locating the target object and bringing it to the furniture where the desklamp is, use the observed numbered lamp instance to execute use desklamp <id>. Do not use examine X with desklamp, examine the target object/desklamp/furniture, or compound use syntax; if invalid syntax has been attempted, verify the desklamp instance name and retry, rather than repeatedly examine. If put to the furniture where the desklamp is repeatedly shows no change, keep holding it and directly use desklamp <id>, do not continue placing."},{"id":"T0248","english":"If use desklamp returns Nothing happens, it usually means you are not at the desklamp's location, the current furniture observation does not list a desklamp, a bare name was used instead of a numbered instance, or the target object has not been taken/the interaction condition is not met; repeating the same use/examine/look command at the same location will not change the state and may form a loop or trigger protection. After one or two consecutive failures, stop repeating. If the target object cannot be placed on the furniture where the desklamp is, and put repeatedly shows no change, do not continue attempting to place, but keep holding it and directly use the desklamp."},{"id":"T0249","english":"Using the desklamp requires being at the same location as the furniture where the desklamp is, and wrong syntax (such as bare-name use desklamp), wrong location, or not holding the target object will not produce a state change; mistaking an empty observation for a retry signal will repeat invalid actions. The placement action itself does not trigger the observation condition, so repeated put failures do not mean the desklamp cannot be used."},{"id":"T0250","english":"After a failure, first verify whether the current furniture observation actually lists desklamp; if not, move to other furniture where the desklamp has been observed, rather than retrying the same use. If the desklamp is present, ensure the target object has been taken or is held, then retry with the numbered use desklamp <id>; if there is still no change, switch to searching other locations or declare that it cannot be completed, do not repeat the same command or fall back to examine. If put to the furniture where the desklamp is repeatedly shows no change, stop placing and keep holding it to directly use desklamp <id>."},{"id":"T0251","english":"After successfully heating while holding, confirm via inventory or held status that the object is still in hand, then go directly to the destination. Unless the object was actually placed into the microwave, do not issue an action to take the object from the microwave."},{"id":"T0252","english":"Do not take, move, or directly navigate to the desklamp itself"},{"id":"T0253","english":"Invalid desklamp interaction: avoid wrong examine/use syntax and complete the final observation"},{"id":"T0254","english":"After an empty result, first verify the location and change strategy, avoid repeating the same command"},{"id":"T0255","english":"Do not treat the desklamp as a takeable or navigable target"}]}
